design_rules: Every placed part has an LCSC field naming an in-stock JLCPCB part; verify the exported BOM with scripts/jlc-stock.ts before ordering.
The I2C bus has exactly one pull-up pair: 4.7k to +3V3 on the esp32-core sheet. Module sheets add no pull-ups.
Vehicle nets (VIN_IN, VIN_RAW, DIN1_RAW, DIN2_RAW, the opto DINx_R/DINx_D, AIN1_RAW, AIN1_MID, DOUT1) use the Vehicle netclass: 0.8 mm clearance; no copper pour in the DIN island.
Bus nets (CAN_H, CAN_L, RS485_A, RS485_B, RS232_TXD, RS232_RXD) use the Bus netclass (0.3 mm, 0.2 mm clearance) and keep their SZNUP3105L / MAX13223E protection within 10 mm of J1.
J1 (Micro-Fit 2x8) pin order is fixed for fault tolerance: no pin may be moved next to +5 V out (pin 4) unless it cannot drive it above 5.5 V; vehicle nets stay on the back row (pins 9-16).
Keep the LIS3MDL magnetometer at least 20 mm from J1, the CR2032 holder, the LM2596 inductor, the BSP75N, USB-C and the ESP32; place MPU-6500 and LIS3MDL with the same orientation.
Route signals on F.Cu and keep B.Cu a near-solid GND pour; stitch GND at 5 mm or finer; widen supply tracks after routing.
Route USB D+/D- as a pair over unbroken GND.
Put the antenna end of the ESP32 module past the board edge; no copper under or around the antenna.
Hour-meter boards are 2-layer: check the layer count, stackup and Gerber L1/L2 before production.
